run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark that times forward and backward passes for composing lists of GTN graphs
run_parallel_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward score benchmark that times forward and backward passes for scoring lists of GTN graphs
run_parallel_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark that times gtn.parallel_for execution over a batch of graphs
review_time_compose: review the time_compose function which benchmarks parallel graph composition using gtn.compose and gtn.backward
review_time_forward_score: review the time_forward_score function which benchmarks parallel forward scoring using gtn.forward_score and gtn.backward
